composites.name: caspule-nfsim-dimer
composites.description: CASPULE bond-aware MD coupled to NFSim rule-based kinetics for a dimerization experiment. Type-1 monomers diffuse on a simple-cubic lattice and form bonds via LAMMPS fix bond/create. The ObservableDetector scans the bond graph each tick, extracts dimers (connected pairs), removes them from the spatial pool, and injects them as molecules into NFSim's non-spatial pool. NFSim then integrates reversible Dimer→Active activation and slow Active decay. This composite demonstrates two-way coupling between spatial MD and rule-based kinetics through the observable detector bridge.

composites.name: caspule-nfsim-polymer
composites.description: CASPULE bond-aware MD coupled to NFSim rule-based kinetics for a polymer fractionation experiment. Type-1 monomers polymerize into branched clusters on a 6x6x6 lattice; each atom can carry up to 4 bonds. The ObservableDetector applies three size-based rules: dimers (size 2) and trimers (size 3) are extracted from the spatial pool and injected into NFSim as distinct molecule types; polymers (size 4+) are observed but kept in the spatial pool so the bond network remains visible. NFSim then integrates distinct decay kinetics for each molecule class (dimers activate quickly, trimers slowly, polymers degrade slowly). This composite demonstrates multi-rule detection and multi-species coupling across spatial and non-spatial simulation regimes.
